S107.20.needs: a signed-in AGI account with the marketplace capability, a public GitHub repository with a marketplace manifest
S107.20.note: The Code line's apps/cli/src/lib.rs:3635 is unrelated: it is the 'Recent project folders' code. The real path is add_marketplace at apps/cli/src/lib.rs:2758 (clap 'marketplace add' at apps/cli/src/lib.rs:2340-2352) and the slash path at apps/cli/src/repl/mod.rs:353. The sources list shows a name and repository URL, but no separate publisher field; the 'Added' line shows only the source name.
steps: Sign in to the AGI CLI with an account that has the marketplace capability (canUseMarketplace). Without it the add step is refused.
In a terminal, type `agi marketplace add owner/repo` for a public GitHub repository that has a marketplace manifest. Optionally add `--ref <branch or tag>` and `--name <name>`.
Look for the line 'Added <name> to your account (<N> plugins).'
Type `agi marketplace sources`. Look for the new row with its id, its name, its status, its plugin count and its repository URL under 'Marketplaces on your account'.
In the chat, type `/plugin`, press the right arrow key until the Marketplaces tab shows, and look for the hint 'agi marketplace add <github url>'.
Compare with Expected: the publisher's marketplace is named (name and repository URL) and its plugins become available.
S107.20.where: Terminal: type `agi marketplace add <owner/repo>` (also in chat: `/marketplace add <owner/repo>`). To view: `agi marketplace sources`, or in chat `/plugin`, then switch to the Marketplaces tab with the right arrow key.
